speaker: Primm
before: Do mind the floor. It has just been polished, by seventeen people, whom I thank daily, in writing.
after: Let us be quick and tidy about this. I have a kingdom to straighten afterwards.

speaker: Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No
before: "The authorization was valid, and it was always valid. But the office is now vacant, and policy is policy."
after: So it was never valid. Ten years of no, filed on a Tuesday. The office is now vacant, and policy is policy.

speaker: The Grand Chef
before: Take my old name: Escoffina. I was always prouder of the work than of the title, and that name could do with somebody making a fresh start in it.
after: Take my given name, Escoffina. Everyone calls me Chef; the name is wasted on me, and it could do with a fresh start.

speaker: The Doppelganger
before: I do not know what to call myself. Your name was the only one I had, and now it is yours again.
after: Your title was the only name I had, and now it is yours again.

speaker: Archdruid Compostella
before: It's the seed, {villain}'s gift: life that never dies. I grew up beneath a great tree, child, and when she fell, I couldn't bear it.
after: It's the seed, {villain}'s gift, carried here by his groundskeeper: life that never dies.

speaker: Hollow Warden
before: Then I will do what I was left here to do.
after: Nobody leaves this cave. I was left here to see to that.

speaker: Prudence Pallor, Checkpoint Supervisor
before: The authorization is valid, and policy states that I must stop you. I have read the whole of the policy, twice, and nowhere does it say why.
after: The transfer of authority is valid, and policy says I must stop you.

speaker: Mortimer Grimsby, CE-No
before: You held 4,000,213, and you did not wait for it to be called. I find that I keep returning to that.
after: Your number was zero, and you did not wait for it to be called.

speaker: The Wanderer
before: Everywhere I go, someone tells me a story about a little prince, and then they look at me and stop talking. You knew me before all this, didn't you?
after: Maren keeps starting a story about a boy at court, then stops. You knew me, didn't you?

speaker: The Rescuer
before: Easy, now. Stay down for a moment and get your breath back. After what they put you through, I'm amazed you're breathing at all.
after: Easy, now. Slowly. Get your breath back before you try to walk.

speaker: Primm
before: That is simply not true. I made the wells, and I made the roads.
after: Decide who you are? I decided who everyone was. I made the wells, and I made the roads.
